behaviors.finding: Verified empty text requires empty_target_verifiedTrue; nonempty text with that flagTrue refuses; boolean flag and verified trimmed final required. Compiler separately rejects unverified EOS-only targets.
behaviors.name: Empty-target flag converse

behaviors.finding: Normalized explicit blocked/protected/CAL/calibration/ANY READ/real FIXTURE roles refuse independently of eligible-looking status. Allowed status plus SHA required. Declarations do not prove ancestry truth.
behaviors.name: Role/status contradictions

behaviors.finding: Exact pinned bytes split only on LF; at most one terminal delimiter removed; blanks/count mismatches refuse; all records decode. CRLF, unterminated final row and Unicode string content survive without row filtering.
behaviors.name: Physical JSONL preservation

behaviors.finding: Prehash, consumed-byte verification and manifest closing hash share limit+1 capped reads. Caps are1MiB for metadata and16MiB for payloads; post-stat growth and between-read changes refuse.
behaviors.name: Bounded custody reads

behaviors.finding: Request-only/wrong-owner/fixture/unadmitted bundles refuse; four independent pinned kind/subject/reviewer/attribution/check receipts precede payload reads. One consistent export author distinct from reviewers and owner thread required; copied native-plan summaries revalidate. This does not authenticate principals or review truth.
behaviors.name: Receipts and exporter closure

behaviors.finding: Exact200/512 quotas, intact alternating histories/parents, two-view pairs, shared parent/family/scenario/lexicon,40grounded T/Fpairs and structural cross-split exclusions. Atomic union grouping preserves all parent/pair components. Semantic evidence pairing and global exclusion remain unproved.
behaviors.name: Complete rows and pair groups

behaviors.finding: Full/prefix rendering matches tokenizer template IDs; final EOS/newline and context budgets checked; all rows compile; response labels final answer+EOS only. Sealed plan revalidates design/source/reviews/raw metadata, masks/EOS, audit, seeded groups and accounting. Revalidation itself does not rerun native tokenization or reread owner files; actual exposure/native custody remain separate.
behaviors.name: Compiler parity and revalidation

limits: Source implementation review for existing owner's consideration, not an owner admission receipt
Actual qualified reservations, exclusions, full passports, gold and independent scientific reviews remain missing
Actual admitted200/512 export, tokenizer fit/exposure, qualification, baseline, blinded outcomes and gains remain unmeasured
content.observation_source: Direct nonauthor collaboration final response, serialized by root
content.scope: Full current bank/compiler source and relevant fixture source plus preserved test XML. No imports, test reruns, real payload reads, models, native execution or edits.

publication_policy: Portable historical evidence only, not an executable packet or admission/qualification permit. Local paths, chat UUIDs and XML hostnames are removed; original raw-file hashes are retained separately from hashes of these exports. No banks, predictions, weights, checkpoints, environments or raw process inventories are exported. Originals remain unchanged outside Git.
